description: We are a team from Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, working on "Abandoned but not Forgotten." Our project, Left on the Moon, is an interactive 3D website that tells the stories of equipment NASA left on the Moon and Mars, and why each piece stayed behind. Our team combines web development, UI/UX and 3D design, research and storytelling. We'd welcome members skilled in 3D modeling, animation or space history who love turning data into stories.
